title: libimage: add space limits to RemoveImagesOptions
body:
Add ReservedSpace, MaxUsedSpace and MinFreeSpace to RemoveImagesOptions so pruning can be bounded by size instead of removing every image matching the filters.  This is needed for the space limit parameters of the Docker API v1.48 POST /build/prune endpoint.

Only the space that removing the filtered images would free counts toward MaxUsedSpace and ReservedSpace, matching how BuildKit only accounts for its build cache.  MinFreeSpace uses the free space of the file system holding the graph root.  Candidates are removed oldest first.  Since containers/storage does not record when an image was last used, they are ordered by creation time.

Space limits are rejected when removing images by name or when negative.  When no limits are set, the existing behavior is kept.

Testing: `sudo go test ./libimage -run 'TestCalculateKeepBytes|TestRemoveImages' -count=1 -v`

Related: podman-container-tools/podman#30173
